references.observed: The modern upstream view shows a narrow curved crest, continuous pale concrete face, the two canyon-side installations, and exposed horizontally layered cliffs at partial reservoir fill.
The builder describes the 203.5 m double-curvature wall, 4.5 m crest thickness and 21 m base thickness, and locates the two surface outlets on the left bank and the generating plant underground.
Downstream photo shows the deep arch with horizontal construction bands and the twin rectangular rock-cut inlet portals behind the eastern end.
Modern photo establishes the rough pale layered geology above the reservoir.
